scope: Planned ordinary legal native matches. A planned kind is not observed coverage; reports retain missing kinds and screenshot phases.
selection_policy: Choose only a currently offered three-camp command, preferring named camps then larger starting hands. No deck or private-state inspection.

scenarios.name: general
scenarios.public_setup: Ordinary 2623 draft, legal actions favor unobserved effects and then offensive progress. Reach an actual victory and let its complete presentation end before showing rematch.

scenarios.name: camp_motion_and_reveal
scenarios.public_setup: Activate Riverboat and Lookout Ridge; obtain a punk and legally reveal it through Masquerade. Draw and queue Box Canyon with multiple deployed people, then choose actual changed positions.

scenarios.name: recruit_and_treat
scenarios.public_setup: Legally deploy people on both sides and damage them; use Jailhouse on a damaged enemy and Army Surgeon's Tent on a damaged ally in another column with room.

scenarios.name: clear_ruins
scenarios.public_setup: Pay an offered discard ability, destroy an actual camp, then use Boarding House to remove that public ruin. Keep the relevant camps alive until their target action is observed.

scenarios.name: withdraw_and_rearrange
scenarios.public_setup: Deploy people, use an offered return ability or Curfew, and resolve Box Canyon with different legal positions.

scenarios.name: deck_depletion
scenarios.public_setup: Both players prioritize legal draws and safe water/draw junk, then pass turns. Recycling creates a discard pile; exhaust the first deck, observe the single legal reshuffle, and exhaust it again for the actual draw ending.

scenarios.name: scientist_analysis
scenarios.public_setup: Legally deploy Prospector or a Con Man that can copy a Prospector, activate analysis, and accept an offered card or Skip response. This adaptive coverage scenario is a plan, not an exact replay or guaranteed result. The separate test_scientist_scene.py seed139 replay records exact branch evidence.
